title: RPPA, the final battles, and economic power in Gaza
summary: A connected inquiry into Revelation 19–20, the mark and economic coercion, Gaza governance and currency proposals, computational theology and accountable authority.

connections.label: Trump and the First Beast
connections.relationship: A specific identification and its institutional evidence
connections.context: The Gaza inquiry tests concentrated governance and proposed payment controls while separating documented policy from the author’s theological identification.

connections.label: Antichrist as a pattern of conduct
connections.relationship: Recurring conduct and a claimed final fulfillment
connections.context: Compare the difference between a recurring mechanism of economic exclusion and a unique final fulfillment.

connections.label: Antichrist and Ridiculous Claims
connections.relationship: The source of the controlled-payment scenario
connections.context: This conversation contains the conditional enclave and payment-rail scenario. Its later turns are not all dated by its export start date, and AI elaboration is not adopted policy.

connections.label: Gaza Coin proposal
connections.context: The 2020 academic Gaza Wallet project must be distinguished from the 2026 Board of Peace stablecoin discussions.

connections.label: Gaza development coalition name
connections.relationship: An invented acronym and a real textual question
connections.context: The archived MA-GOG communiqué is an imaginative draft, not an official announcement. Compare actual governance sources and Revelation’s Gog and Magog imagery.

connections.label: Computational theology argument map
connections.relationship: Computational analogy and an empirical research design
connections.context: RPPA needs explicit inputs, variables and counterevidence without presenting its computational analogy as an established model.

connections.label: Computational Divine Immanence
connections.context: Connect the model/action distinction with prophetic deep-pattern reasoning and the causal effects of belief.

connections.label: Religion for conscious robots
connections.context: What would keep an intelligent intermediary answerable to people affected by its decisions? The Gaza comparison is conditional and does not establish an AGI deployment.

connections.label: Sacred inheritance and rival continuations
connections.relationship: Interpretive authority and the root-access analogy
connections.context: The technical metaphor highlights who can change rules; it does not equate institutions or turn scripture into literal executable code.

connections.label: Apocalyptic Repair Theology
connections.context: Economic freedom, truthful dissent, appeal and practical correction remain evaluable without first establishing a final prophetic identity.

connections.label: AGI Religious Framework
connections.relationship: Ethical education and its coercive inversion
connections.context: The new three-variable matrix distinguishes Micah’s machine-education proposal from the AI’s suggested doctrines and from an unverified system for policing human wallets.
